what_it_does: LiquidGEMM is a hardware-efficient kernel for performing 4-bit weight, 8-bit activation matrix multiplication operations on GPUs to accelerate large language model inference. The approach uses specialized quantization techniques that require only 2 arithmetic instructions per 4 elements, enabling fast conversion of compressed weights back to full precision. It also overlaps weight loading, conversion, and matrix operations without synchronization overhead, matching tensor core throughput.
